Join the lab

The Sledzieski Lab at UCSD is currently recruiting across all levels. We are recruiting candidates with computational and/or biology experience; interdisciplinary training is valued but not required. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, especially those traditionally under-represented in computing and in the life sciences. If you are unsure whether you would be a good fit for the lab, don’t hesitate to email me to ask.

PhD students

I will be recruiting PhD students to start in Fall 2027. Prospective students should apply through either the Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute or Bioinformatics and Systems Biology (BISB) PhD programs. Please mention my name in your application to be sure that I see it!

If you are already a UCSD PhD student: send me an email with [SL-PHD] in the subject to discuss whether a position in the lab makes sense.

PhD Funding Opportunities:

  • NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program
  • DOE Computational Science Graduate Fellowship
  • Hertz Fellowship

Postdocs

I am currently recruiting a computational postdoc to start in Fall 2027. Interested candidates should send me an email with [SL-POSTDOC] in the subject. Please attach your CV, a short description of your research interests, and some representative publications.

Postdoc Funding Opportunities:

  • UCSD Guide: Finding Funding Opportunities
  • Schmidt AI in Science Postdoc
  • UCSD Chancellor’s Postdoctoral Fellowship
  • FutureHouse AI-for-Science Independent Postdoctoral Fellowship
  • NIH K99/R00

Undergraduate and Masters students

We are always looking for motivated undergraduate and masters students that want to gain research experience, often as part of a thesis project. Please include [SL-UNDERGRADUATE] or [SL-MASTERS] in the subject, and include a brief description of the lab project(s) that you are interested in. Prior research experience is not required.
